gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/concern/structure/manifest.toml)

Checks that every tracked file over the size limit is stored through LFS or declared with a reason.

## Why

A large file in plain git history stays in every clone for good.

## What to do

Track the file with git lfs, classify it with gspot set generated <path> or gspot set vendored <path>, or raise limits.file_size_kb with a reason.

## Where it runs

- Preset: [the structure preset](/reference/presets/structure/)
- Stage: commit
- Level: all
- Engine: integrity

Turn it off for a path with a reason: `gspot ignore integrity/large-files --paths <glob> --reason "<why>"`.
